Class EngineConfig

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.config.EngineConfig
public final class EngineConfig extends Object
MachineEngine's own settings (plugins/MachineEngine/config.yml), generated from SPEC. Read them with MachineEngine.config().get(EngineConfig.MAX_MACHINES_PER_CHUNK).
